  "overall_rating": 4,
  "value_for_money_rating": 4,
  "customer_support_rating": 3,
  "recommendation_score": 8,
  "pros": [
    "Intuitive interface makes generating standard accounting reports straightforward.",
    "Cloud-based access allows for flexible report generation from any location.",
    "Dashboard provides a quick overview of financial health before diving into detailed reports."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Customizing reports for specific hospitality industry metrics can be cumbersome.",
    "Occasionally experiences slower loading times when dealing with larger data sets.",
    "Reliance on third-party integrations for advanced operational insights can complicate report consolidation."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Admin Assistant found Xero to be a reliable tool for their report generation tasks over two years, appreciating its user-friendly design. While standard accounting reports were easily created, they noted that tailoring reports for specific hospitality needs sometimes required extra effort. Overall, Xero served its purpose effectively for their mid-sized company's accounting reporting requirements."
